_comment: Third-party skills are NOT copied into this repo. install.py downloads them from the original authors' GitHub repos at the commit listed in 'pinned' (reviewed 2026-11-06). Use --latest to take the newest default branch instead.

upstream.title: REA - Reverse Engineer Anything
upstream.note: The skill drives the REA tool. For full power also run: npx skills add morluto/rea (installs REA tooling) or see https://github.com/morluto/rea. A lighter alternative exists: aicodeking/leanrea.

upstream.title: Secure Claude Skills (auth, CSRF, rate limiting, input validation, error handling, headers ...)
upstream.note: You wrote 'security-auth-skill' without an author. This is the closest match found (Clerk/Next.js/Convex oriented). Swap the repo in this file if you meant another one.

upstream.title: Google Stitch skills
upstream.note: Needs the Stitch MCP server and a Stitch account/API key to do anything useful.

upstream.title: Scroll World (scroll-scrubbed 3D landing pages)
upstream.note: Generating assets costs money (Monid or Higgsfield credits) and needs ffmpeg + Python Pillow. The skill states the estimate before spending.

upstream.title: Frontend Slides
upstream.note: PowerPoint conversion needs: pip install python-pptx Pillow

upstream.title: AI Website Cloner (/clone-website)
upstream.note: Upstream is a Next.js project template. Only the skill is installed here; for the full flow use 'Use this template' on GitHub. Only clone sites you have the right to copy.

upstream.title: Awesome DESIGN.md (84 brand design systems)
upstream.note: Upstream has no SKILL.md (it is a collection of DESIGN.md files). The installer downloads the collection and adds the wrapper skill from this repo.

upstream.title: Impeccable (design commands: audit, polish, critique ...)
upstream.note: Upstream also ships a CLI: npx impeccable. See https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable

upstream.title: Vercel Web Interface Guidelines review
upstream.license: see upstream (no LICENSE file at repo root when reviewed)
upstream.note: At run time this skill fetches the latest rules from raw.githubusercontent.com/vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines.

mcp.title: Playwright MCP (Microsoft)
mcp.note: This is an MCP server, not a skill. It is registered with 'claude mcp add'. It downloads @playwright/mcp from npm each run.

manual.title: AiSOC (open-source AI security operations center)
manual.note: AiSOC is a full self-hosted platform (Docker Compose, about 8 GB RAM), NOT a Claude skill, so it is not auto-installed. It does ship an MCP server (@aisoc/mcp) that talks to YOUR running AiSOC instance: claude mcp add aisoc -- npx -y @aisoc/mcp --aisoc-url https://YOUR-AISOC --api-key YOUR_KEY. Project README: https://github.com/beenuar/AiSOC
